cameras.aerial: aerial drone shot, sweeping over the scene
cameras.pan: slow scenic pan from left to right
cameras.pull_out: slow pull-out revealing the full scene
cameras.push_in: slow push-in, growing sense of intimacy
cameras.tracking: smooth tracking shot following the subject

keyword_map: at golden hour, warm sunset light

generic.label: Generic 通用
generic.negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, distorted, deformed
generic.suggested: universal structure: subject + action + scene + camera + lighting + style

kling.label: Kling 可灵
kling.negative: deformed hands, extra fingers, blurry, low quality, watermark, distorted face, morphing face
kling.suggested: duration 5-10s · aspect 16:9 or 9:16 · image-to-video friendly wording, one clear action per shot

runway.label: Runway
runway.negative: blurry, distorted, watermark, low quality, flickering
runway.suggested: add Camera Controls separately in Runway UI (pan / tilt / zoom); keep prompt focused on subject + motion

sora.label: Sora
sora.negative: physically implausible motion, distorted anatomy, text artifacts, watermark
sora.suggested: long descriptive prompt works best; describe physics, materials and timing explicitly

veo.label: Veo
veo.suggested: cinematic wording; add an Audio line if you need ambience / dialogue cues

anime.suffix: anime style, clean line art, vibrant colors, studio-quality animation

cinematic.suffix: cinematic, film grain, shallow depth of field, 24fps motion feel

commercial.suffix: high-end commercial look, clean composition, premium product-film quality

photorealistic.suffix: photorealistic, ultra detailed, 8k, realistic skin texture
